fallback_reachability: handle_tensors asks quantize() only for F32, F16 or BF16. F32/F16 are astype (never raise); BF16 has block size 1, so can_quantize is always true and QuantError cannot occur for a 1-D or larger tensor. The fallback is reached only by a test-only injected QuantError (the package's own class), on one BF16 tensor, identically in both revisions (cases H2 and H4).
